dag_infos.description: Taiwan historical minimum-wage benchmark indices; not age-specific youth salary.

data_infos.name_cn: 歷年基本工資／最低工資基準指數
data_infos.source_type: 勞動部官方歷年基本工資／最低工資 HTML
data_infos.dataset_description: 以民國110年月基本工資24,000元、時基本工資160元為100的全國基準指數；原始金額保留於 breakdown，無年齡欄位。
data_infos.etl_description: Fetch both official HTML pages with a browser User-Agent, parse p/li history entries, convert ROC years to Gregorian dates, deduplicate overlapping pages, and emit monthly/hourly index rows. No youth age is inferred and no 18-35 scaling is materialized. Input amount count and output row count are reconciled; adjacent-period scale guards detect abnormal magnitudes.
